name: snyk
description: Snyk security scanning, remediation, dependency health, and findings export for Codex, powered by the local Snyk CLI MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Find, fix, and export security issues with Snyk
interface.longDescription: Scan code, open-source dependencies, infrastructure as code, container images, and secrets with the local Snyk CLI. Fix issues with a guided remediation workflow, vet new dependencies before adding them, and export findings with their supporting evidence as structured JSON.
defaultPrompt: Scan this repo with Snyk and fix what you find
Is this package safe to add to my project?
